grading_system.evidence: U-32 uses a proficiency-based grading system when reporting grades. Students need 3 proficient products in each of the 6 literacy standards.

schedule.evidence: Registration checklist: "Sign up for at least 14 and select alternatives." Courses are listed as 1 semester, 2 semester, or year-long. Number of classes per term is not stated.

credit_definition.text: not_stated: the catalog gives no credit values; graduation is by proficiencies (SLOs), and no credit conversion is stated.
credit_definition.evidence: No credit values are stated in the catalog.

course_load.min_courses_or_credits: full course-load expected; number not stated (registration: at least 14 course requests)
course_load.evidence: Each student is expected to carry a full course-load.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Graduation is by proficiency in WCUUSD Student Learning Outcomes, not credits. Areas: Literacy (3 proficient products in each of 6 standards, at least 10 products); Math (4 standards, can be met via Geometry, Algebra I, Algebra II); Science (proficiency once in each PI for every standard in at least 3 domains); PE & Health (5 standards); Artistic Expression (4 standards); Financial Literacy (3 standards); Global Citizenship/World Language (3 standards); Transferable Skills (6 standards). No total credit count stated.

flexible_pathways_listed: Vermont Dual Enrollment (two tuition-free college courses for juniors and seniors)
concurrent dual enrollment with Community College of Vermont
Multi-Year Plan / alternate credit accrual plan (IEP/504)
study abroad (proficiency via portfolio and educator review)
notes: Proficiency-based graduation; no credit total is stated. Required local items: Personalized Learning Plan reviewed and updated annually (p.16); English Graduation Portfolio; Health and PE via PE1A, PE1B, PE II and Health; Financial Literacy course; Global Studies, Democratic Roots and US History courses. Full-time status requires a full course-load; part-time status is subject to administrative approval. Early College requires five college classes per semester in senior year. GPA is unweighted: course score 4 = 4.0, 3 = 3.5, 2 = 2.5, 1 = 1.5 (p.16). Only courses meeting SLO proficiency factor into GPA. The catalog does not state courses per term or a schedule type (block vs. period).
